declarations.description:
Placeholder block standing in for content that has not arrived. Three shapes: a `rect` (the default) for images,
cards and buttons, `text` for one or more lines of copy, and `circle` (sized by its own variable) for avatars.
`lines` repeats a text skeleton with a shorter last line, the way a paragraph ends. The `animation` is a `pulse`
by default, `wave` for a sheen sweeping across it, or `none` for a still block; reduced motion stops all three.

A skeleton is decoration, so it is hidden from assistive technology and the region it fills should carry
`aria-busy="true"` instead. Give one skeleton in a group a `label` to announce the wait itself.
declarations.name: Skeleton

cssProperties.description: Width of the block. Ignored by `circle`, which sizes itself.
cssProperties.name: --c2-skeleton--width

cssProperties.description: Height of the block, or of one line of a `text` skeleton.
cssProperties.name: --c2-skeleton--height

cssProperties.description: Rounding; `circle` overrides it with a full round.
cssProperties.name: --c2-skeleton--border-radius

cssProperties.description: Length of one pulse or wave cycle.
cssProperties.name: --c2-skeleton--animation-duration

cssProperties.description: Space between the lines of a `text` skeleton.
cssProperties.name: --c2-skeleton--gap

cssProperties.description: Width of the final line when `lines` is more than one.
cssProperties.name: --c2-skeleton__last-line--width

cssProperties.description: Diameter of a `circle` skeleton; it sets both axes so it cannot go oval.
cssProperties.name: --c2-skeleton__circle--size

members.name: animation
members.description: How the block animates while it waits.

members.name: lines
members.description: Number of lines drawn by the `text` variant; the last one is shortened. Ignored by the other variants.

members.name: label
members.description: Announce the wait on this skeleton. Leave empty on the rest of a group so the message is not repeated.

members.name: lineCount
members.description: Line count, floored at one, and only meaningful for the `text` variant.
